title: Charging an R32 AC? Use the right gas
description: Sealed R32 refrigerant cylinders for inverter split ACs, from established makers. AR Cooling Solutions, Hyderabad.
headline: Charging an R32 AC? |Use the right gas.
bullets: R32 for new inverter split ACs
Sealed cylinders from established makers
Match the gas to the unit's nameplate
caption: Servicing an inverter split AC? Most new ones run on R32. We supply sealed R32 cylinders from established makers such as SRF (Floron) and GFL. R32 is mildly flammable, so use R32-rated tools and good ventilation, and never top up an R22 or R410A unit with it. Check the unit's nameplate and tell us the gas you need.
